arxiv-2102-05620.title: Constant-rate inflation: primordial black holes from conformal weight transitions
arxiv-2102-05620.creator: and Yi-Peng Wu
arxiv-2102-05620.description: Abstract Constant-rate inflation, including ultra-slow-roll inflation as a special case, has been widely applied to the formation of primordial black holes with a significant deviation from the standard slow-roll conditions at both the growing and decaying phases of the power spectrum.

arxiv-2103-05720.title: Power-Balanced Hybrid Optics Boosted Design for Achromatic Extended-Depth-of-Field Imaging via Optimized Mixed OTF Journal: optica
arxiv-2103-05720.creator: Seyyed Reza Miri Rostami, Samuel Pinilla, Igor Shevkunov, Vladimir Katkovnik, Karen Egiazarian
arxiv-2103-05720.description: Abstract The power-balanced hybrid optical imaging system is a special design of a diffractive computational camera, introduced in this paper, with image formation by a refractive lens and Multilevel Phase Mask (MPM). This system provides a long focal depth with low chromatic aberrations thanks to MPM and a high energy light concentration due to the refractive lens.

arxiv-2310-04444.title: What’s the Magic Word? A Control Theory of LLM Prompting
arxiv-2310-04444.creator: Aman Bhargava, Cameron Witkowski, Shi-Zhuo Looi, Matt Thomson
arxiv-2310-04444.description: Abstract Prompt engineering is crucial for deploying LLMs but is poorly understood mathematically. We formalize LLM systems as a class of discrete stochastic dynamical systems to explore prompt engineering through the lens of control theory. We offer a mathematical analysis of the limitations on the controllability of self-attention as a function of the singular values of the parameter matrices.

arxiv-2409-00492.title: Accurate Compression of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Vector Quantization
arxiv-2409-00492.creator: Vage Egiazarian *, Denis Kuznedelev *, Anton Voronov *, Ruslan Svirschevski, Michael Goin, Daniil Pavlov, Dan Alistarh, Dmitry Baranchuk
arxiv-2409-00492.description: Abstract Text-to-image diffusion models have emerged as a powerful framework for high-quality image generation given textual prompts. Their success has driven the rapid development of production-grade diffusion models that consistently increase in size and already contain billions of parameters. As a result, state-of-the-art text-to-image models are becoming less accessible in practice, especially in resource-limited environments.

arxiv-2508-07668.title: AIS-LLM: A Unified Framework for Maritime Trajectory Prediction, Anomaly Detection, and Collision Risk Assessment with Explainable Forecasting
arxiv-2508-07668.creator: Hyobin Park, Jinwook Jung, Minseok Seo, Hyunsoo Choi, Deukjae Cho, Sekil Park, Dong-Geol Choi
arxiv-2508-07668.description: Abstract With the increase in maritime traffic and the mandatory implementation of the Automatic Identification System (AIS), the importance and diversity of maritime traffic analysis tasks based on AIS data, such as vessel trajectory prediction, anomaly detection, and collision risk assessment, is rapidly growing.

arxiv-2509-01681.title: GaussianGAN: Real-Time Photorealistic controllable Human Avatars
arxiv-2509-01681.creator: Mohamed Ilyes Lakhal, Richard Bowden CVSSP, University of Surrey, Guildford, United Kingdom {m.lakhal, r.bowden}@surrey.ac.uk
arxiv-2509-01681.description: Abstract Photorealistic and controllable human avatars have gained popularity in the research community thanks to rapid advances in neural rendering, providing fast and realistic synthesis tools. However, a limitation of current solutions is the presence of noticeable blurring. To solve this problem, we propose GaussianGAN, an animatable avatar approach developed for photorealistic rendering of people in real-time.

arxiv-2509-16920.title: SwarmChat: An LLM-Based, Context-Aware Multimodal Interaction System for Robotic Swarms Thanks: This paper has been accepted and presented at the 16th International Conference on Swarm Intelligence (ICSI 2025), held on July 11–15, 2025, in Yokohama, Japan.
arxiv-2509-16920.creator: Ettilla Mohiuddin Eumi, Hussein Abbass, Nadine Marcus
arxiv-2509-16920.description: Abstract Traditional Human-Swarm Interaction (HSI) methods often lack intuitive real-time adaptive interfaces, making decision making slower and increasing cognitive load while limiting command flexibility. To solve this, we present SwarmChat, a context-aware, multimodal interaction system powered by Large Language Models (LLMs).

arxiv-2601-09527.title: Private LLM Inference on Consumer Blackwell GPUs: A Practical Guide for Cost-Effective Local Deployment in SMEs
arxiv-2601-09527.creator: Jonathan Knoop, Hendrik Holtmann
arxiv-2601-09527.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Jonathan Knoop, Hendrik Holtmann. SMEs increasingly seek alternatives to cloud LLM APIs, which raise data privacy concerns. Dedicated cloud GPU instances offer improved privacy but with limited guarantees and ongoing costs, while professional on-premise hardware (A100, H100) remains prohibitively expensive.

pmc-10510158.title: Clinical manifestation, staging and prognosis of hepatocellular carcinoma in Gambian patients
pmc-10510158.creator: Sheikh Omar Bittaye, Abubacarr Kambi, Momodou A. I. Tekanyi, Saydiba Tamba, Lamin Sanneh, Momodou Musa Sisawo, Abdoulie Jatta, Gibril Fatty, Adam Jeng, Momodou Salieu Jallow, Ousman Leigh, Ramou Njie
pmc-10510158.description: BackgroundAs a result of the lack of screening programs and the difficulty in making a proper diagnosis, the majority of hepatocellular carcinoma (HHC) patients present late in low-resource countries. The study therefore assesses the clinical features, stage and prognostic variables of patients with HCC in The Gambia.

pmc-11444979.title: Plant-based diets–impacts of consumption of little or no animal-source foods on human health
pmc-11444979.creator: Alice V. Stanton
pmc-11444979.description: The world, in 2024, faces both climate and biodiversity crises, and the food system does contribute significantly to these crises. For some, the solution is simple - intakes of animal source foods (ASFs) should be considerably reduced, and consumption of plant-source foods (PSFs) should be greatly increased.

pmc-11645826.title: O081 Neural aperiodic activity as a novel objective measure of wakefulness in patients undergoing a maintenance of wakefulness test
pmc-11645826.creator: K Seow, A Chatburn, M Bay, T Kang, S Johnston, A Yeo, K Lushington
pmc-11645826.description: BackgroundThe maintenance of wakefulness test (MWT) measures the ability of an individual to stay awake and is used to assess treatment response for conditions of hypersomnolence. The MWT is a laborious test with a strict and standardised protocol. The interpretation of a MWT and what is deemed ‘normal’ is also fraught with debate.

pmc-12563077.title: The Interventional Effects and Mechanisms of Lonidamine in Combination with Apigenin on Colorectal Cancer
pmc-12563077.creator: Yi Zhou, Jiahao Shi, Mengjie Zhang, Hua Yang, Jian Fei, Stergios Boussios, Anna Kawiak
pmc-12563077.description: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is the second most prevalent cancer globally and remains a significant cause of cancer-related mortality. The limited efficacy and toxicities of conventional therapies underscore the urgent need for novel treatments. Lonidamine (LND), a synthetic indazole-3-carboxylic acid derivative, possesses anticancer properties, yet its clinical use is limited by toxic side effects.

pmc-13403657.title: Effects of bio-slurry and chemical fertilizer on soil fertility and productivity of bread wheat (Triticum aestivum L.) in Northwestern Ethiopia
pmc-13403657.creator: Zerubabel Moges Amare, Fenta Assefa, Teferi Alem, Yezbie Kassa, Hunachew Andualem, Dessie Tibebe
pmc-13403657.description: BackgroundDeclining soil fertility and rising mineral fertilizer costs severely constrain wheat production in Ethiopia, threatening food security. Bio-slurry from biogas digesters offers a potential low-cost organic amendment, but limited field evidence exists on its integrated use with chemical fertilizers.MethodsA two-year field experiment (2023/2024–2024/2025) was conducted at the University of Gondar Shinta Research Farm, northwestern Ethiopia.

pmc-13568824.title: MeTime: an R package for reproducible longitudinal metabolomics data analysis
pmc-13568824.creator: Bharadwaj Marella, Patrick Weinisch, Lara Vehovec, Vinh Tran, Josef J Bless, Yacoub A Njipouombe Nsangou, Gabi Kastenmüller, Matthias Arnold
pmc-13568824.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryMeTime is an opensource R package for reproducible analysis of longitudinal metabolomics data. It builds upon a central S4 container, metime_analyser, that stores multiple datasets, associated metadata and analysis outputs, enabling unified handling of complex longitudinal studies. Analyses are constructed by piping modular functions, beginning with data transformations (mod_*), followed by calculations (calc_*), and optional meta-analysis (meta_*), so entire workflows remain transparent and easy to modify.

pmc-13584682.title: Improving fatigue resistance of translucent 4Y‐PSZ zirconia through glass gradation
pmc-13584682.creator: Felipe Machado Souza, Larissa M M Alves, Edisa O Sousa, Tiago Moreira Bastos Campos, Giovana Assis Marcolino, Mariana Miranda de Toledo Piza, Rainã S Dias, Satoshi Yamaguchi, Petra C Gierthmuehlen, Lukasz Witek, Paulo G Coelho, Estevam A Bonfante, Ernesto B Benalcazar‐Jalkh
